title: Fix the Broken Entry Point
description: The program should run as a standalone Java application and print a message.
actualProblem: main's parameter is declared as String args instead of String[] args. The JVM only recognizes the exact signature public static void main(String[] args) as the program's entry point, so it reports 'Error: Main method not found'.
explanation: The JVM looks for main with this precise signature — a String array parameter — to know where to start execution. Any deviation, like a plain String instead of String[], means the JVM can't find a runnable entry point.
